The '''Battle of Antamont''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Antamont]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was fought between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

==The battle==
Antamont, an nonindustrial, green planet covered in mountains, was the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stronghold during the Clone Wars. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces targeted the base, and sent hordes of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2 grapple droid/Legends|grapple droids]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|dwarf spider droids]], and [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droids]] through the mountains toward the base. The path was littered with Republic landmines, which caused much damage to the onrushing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces.

[[File:Lone_battle_droid_freedom.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The battle rages on as a [[Lone battle droid|single battle droid]] retires]]
The CIS and Republic eventually clashed in a valley. As their infantry approached each other, each side began firing missiles at each other. Though the majority of the battle was conducting with infantry and land vehicles, atmospheric combat between each force also occurred.

==Aftermath==
The battle left many destroyed battle droids strewn all over Antamont, which were often found by local farmers. [[Lone battle droid|One such droid]], who had deserted the battle, was found in working condition and brought back to a [[Farm/Legends|ranch]] by two farmers.
